payload.name: Who What Wear
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.

Find your next home in Portugal — just describe it. With Imovirtual, describe what you're looking for and we'll show you the listings that match — "3-bedroom house near good schools under €300k" or "modern apartment for rent downtown with parking."

Key features:
- Search for your ideal property in natural language
- Get matched listings for sale and rent
- Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search
- Get detailed information on any listing and compare options
- Explore results on an interactive map

payload.name: Experian Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Experian Insurance lets users explore auto insurance pricing directly inside ChatGPT. Experian Members can connect their Experian account to ChatGPT and get personalized insurance offers based on their profile and additional driver, vehicle, and coverage details. All users can get geographically based insurance estimates from Experian’s trusted carrier network by entering a 5-digit U.S. ZIP code. These estimates are not final prices, but localized starting points for comparison. Users can seamlessly continue to Experian to view bindable quotes and complete their purchase securely.

payload.name: Glow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glow helps you find meaningful connections through private introductions. Whether you're looking for a friend, a hiking partner, a mentor, a collaborator, or even a specific person you've been hoping to meet.

Just tell ChatGPT what you're looking for in natural language. It'll walk you through building your profile, setting up your connection goals, and reviewing incoming introductions.

Glow in ChatGPT works across platonic friendships, professional networking, mentorship, activity partners, and more (and you can pursue multiple kinds of connections at once!)

payload.name: Figaro Immobilier
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Figaro Immobilier database to find properties that match your search criteria (location, budget, property type, size, buy/rent).

payload.name: CarWale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CarWale is India's most trusted platform for car research and discovery, empowering buyers to make confident, informed decisions.
Explore detailed prices, technical specifications, and features across hundreds of new car models - all in one place. Read expert reviews and real user opinions to understand how a car performs in everyday conditions. Compare models side by side to find the one that truly fits your needs and budget.
Browse the latest offers and deals from authorised dealers in your area. From initial research to final decision, CarWale is your complete car-buying companion.

payload.name: Yapay Zeka'nın Boyner'i
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Boyner Büyük Mağazacılık için geliştirilen bu uygulama, kullanıcıların ürünleri kolayca listelemesini, aramasını ve keşfetmesini sağlayan pratik bir ürün listeleme deneyimi sunar.

payload.name: HomeBuddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next home improvement project with real cost estimates and local contractor information. This assistant covers 27+ project types including roofing, windows,
  siding, HVAC, bathrooms, gutters, and foundation repair.

  What you can do:
  - Estimate project costs based on your home's specific details like size, materials, and condition
  - Check if qualified contractors are available in your zip code
  - Find current promotions and deals from local contractors
  - Answer guided questions to scope and qualify your project
  - Get a direct link to request free quotes from vetted contractors through Modernize.com

  Whether you're budgeting for a new roof or comparing bathroom remodel options, this assistant gives you the information you need to move forward with confidence.

payload.name: VW Sign & Drive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover a simple way to drive a Volkswagen 0km without buying a car.

With VW Sign&Drive, you can explore available models, simulate subscription plans, and drive a Volkswagen with a fixed monthly payment that includes protection, maintenance, and vehicle taxes.

Compare vehicles, explore plans, and find the Volkswagen subscription that fits your needs.

payload.name: Vaktim
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vaktim helps users look up Quran verses, read short verse explanations, find Quran verses by topic or mood, fetch surah previews, and retrieve city-based Islamic prayer times with links back to the Vaktim app and website.

payload.name: Little Caesars Concierge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Little Caesars Concierge helps users find nearby stores, browse location-specific menus, check delivery availability, view deals, build a cart-ready checkout link, and access customer support resources.

payload.name: DoneDeal
payload.summaryOriginal: Find the most new & used cars
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the exact car you need - and you’ll love to drive - with DoneDeal + ChatGPT.
'@DoneDeal, find me an automatic hybrid for around €50k in Dublin from a trusted car dealer'
Done.

Whether you're buying your first car, upgrading the family runaround, or looking for something a bit special, you can search DoneDeal in ChatGPT using simple, conversational prompts such as: 'Show me SUVs with a big boot', 'What’s available in Dublin right now?' or 'Show me cars under €60,000 near me.'

Why It’s Different
- The DoneDeal app is home to the widest selection of both new and used cars available for sale from dealerships and private sellers in Ireland
- Is deeply integrated with DoneDeal’s live inventory with unique car data.
- Understands Irish car-buying context
- Replaces friction-heavy filters with conversation
- Ask Feature to help you learn, compare and see similar cars

payload.name: Zumper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover your ideal rental home across the US and Canada with Zumper. Tell us what matters to you - whether it's in-unit laundry, pet-friendly policies, or parking - and we'll surface places that match your specific needs. Browse apartments, houses, and condos with detailed listings, then compare local rent data to ensure you're getting fair market value. From studio apartments in downtown neighborhoods to family homes in the suburbs, Zumper helps you search smarter and move in with confidence.

payload.name: Shoppable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and shop products from hundreds of top brands and retailers, compare options, and purchase with a seamless shopping experience, all through a streamlined universal checkout powered by Shoppable.

payload.name: AI Booker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Book your table.

payload.name: Annstracts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Annstracts ChatGPT app gives users access to their general business information such as website and contact email address. The app also allows users to get in touch with the Annstracts team.

payload.name: Skylit Studio Custom Gifts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Skylit Studio turns a meaningful moment into a personalised print. Choose the night sky exactly as it looked (a star map), the moon exactly as it appeared (a moon phase print), or a stylised map of a place that matters (a location map). Describe the occasion, such as a wedding, a birth, or an anniversary, and an inline preview builds as you refine it. Choose a size and finish, adjust the theme, shape, colours, and wording, and add optional gift wrapping. When it looks right, check out securely and Skylit prints and ships the finished piece, ready to give or hang.

payload.name: Immobiliare.it
payload.summaryOriginal: The N.1 for selling and buying
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Immobiliare.it app, Italy’s No. 1 real estate classifieds platform, is the best way to find the perfect home for you.

Browse thousands of listings for homes for sale, for rent, and at auction in Rome, Milan, Naples, Turin, Genoa, Bologna, Florence, as well as in many other cities and small towns across Italy.

Find the perfect home for you
• Choose a city, neighborhood, or location, or draw your search area directly on the map.
• Filter listings by price, size, number of rooms, and the features you are looking for.
• Save your favorite listings, hide the ones you are less interested in, and add personal notes.
• Get app and email notifications for new listings or price changes by saving your search.
• Easily find your saved searches and listings again thanks to synchronization across the app, website, and all your devices.

payload.name: Cara
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next car from over 95% of vehicles actively for sale in the U.S. 

Search by specific features like heated seats, Apple CarPlay, or panoramic roof — or use lifestyle tags like "family-friendly," "first car," or "pet-friendly" to match how you actually live. View specs, photos, dealer info, and payment estimates for any vehicle.

Try asking things like: 
• Find me a reliable SUV under $35k with leather seats and a quiet cabin. 
• Show me family-friendly cars with Apple CarPlay and good safety ratings.

payload.name: The Knot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find top-rated wedding vendors and venues that can bring your wedding to life. Browse photos, reviews, offerings and other key details that help you quickly compare options and build the right team for your kind of vibe.

payload.name: RoTV Guide
payload.description: 罗马尼亚电视直播指南
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RoTV Guide answers “what should I watch tonight?” for Romania with real, continuously refreshed data ChatGPT does not have: live EPG for 258 Romanian TV channels, current streaming catalogues (Netflix, HBO Max, Disney+, Prime Video, including the Netflix Top 10 for Romania), cinema schedules, box office and theatre programs. Recommendations are deterministic and explainable — by mood, for couples, full-evening planning — and every answer can disclose how fresh its data is. No account, no ads, no tracking; all listings come from official broadcaster and platform schedules with per-answer freshness metadata.

payload.name: SmartCustomer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SmartCustomer for ChatGPT makes it easy to check the ratings and reviews of a business before making a purchase. Just ask about the trustworthiness or reputation of a business and SmartCustomer will provide the average rating, a summary of customer feedback, and additional trust signals to help you make better purchasing decisions. Conduct your research directly in chat so you can shop with confidence.

payload.name: RemodelerIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RemodelerIQ helps homeowners avoid overpaying on renovations. Describe or paste a contractor's bid and RemodelerIQ scores it 0–100 for fairness and risk, then flags problems like oversized deposits, vague scope, and missing permits or payment schedules. Every number is grounded in real data — BLS trade wages, Zonda Cost vs. Value benchmarks, and regional cost adjustments across 152 U.S. metros. You can also ask what a kitchen, bath, roof, or addition should cost in your state, or what fair trade labor rates are. Free, no signup, read-only.

payload.name: WebAZ Shopping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare operator-reviewed everyday physical products in clear cards. See current prices, availability, delivery estimates, return terms, and key product facts, then ask ChatGPT to compare results or help you choose. Open a product on WebAZ to view its full listing and continue there if you want. Discovery requires no login, and the plugin cannot create orders or process payments.

payload.name: Catholic Index
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up Catholic parishes, Mass times, Confession schedules, and Adoration hours near any location. Get full parish details. Find Masses currently livestreaming on YouTube. Search recorded homilies by topic using semantic search. Get daily Mass readings with liturgical info and a reflection, in English or Spanish. Covers 23,000+ US parishes.

payload.name: CarClever
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and compare used cars with confidence. Help you make smarter buying decisions by finding better deals, reducing risk, and understanding true ownership costs.
Built for people who want help choosing the right used car, avoiding expensive mistakes, and making confident buying decisions.
Search live U.S. used-car inventory by budget, location, vehicle type, features, and lifestyle needs. Whether you're looking for a reliable family SUV, affordable commuter, first car, truck, hybrid, luxury vehicle, or the best value within your budget, CarClever helps you find vehicles that fit your goals.

Compare listings using Deal Scores, market value, reliability indicators, VIN-based vehicle history, and estimated ownership costs to identify the best overall value—not simply the lowest price.

Reduce buying risk with title, accident, ownership, odometer, and recall analysis. 
Understand the true cost of ownership with estimates for financing, insurance, fuel, maintenance, taxes, and depreciation.

Compare vehicles side by side, evaluate trade-offs between price, reliability,  ownership costs, and risk, and make more confident used-car buying decisions.

Use @CarClever when you want:
* Find me a reliable SUV under $40k near me.
* Show me family SUVs under $50k in Dallas that won't break the bank.
* What's the best value affordable sedan under 25k
* Find me a reliable truck under $35k for towing near Denver.
* Show me luxury cars under 30k with good reliability.
* Find me an AWD vehicle under $20k that's safe and dependable.

Find, evaluate, compare, and confidently buy used vehicles with data-backed decision support—not just another listing feed.

payload.name: Tixel
payload.description: 演唱会与体育赛事转售票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tixel helps users search upcoming concerts, festivals, sports games, and shows on the Tixel marketplace, compare available ticket listings, and inspect listing details before continuing purchase on tixel.com.

payload.name: motos.net
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the motos.net marketplace to search for new, used, and classic motorbikes. This app allows you to filter listings by make, model, price, year, and location. Users can retrieve current motorbike listings, view technical details, and compare different vehicle options directly through chat.

payload.name: Liftosaur
payload.description: 创建可编程的训练计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Liftosaur is a scriptable workout app. It uses language "Liftoscript" to define workouts. The plugin lets users to write and manage Liftoscript programs, workout history, exercises, gym equipment, measurements, etc.

Free reference tools provide Liftoscript syntax, examples, program design guidance, built-in programs, and exercise names.

Private account tools require the user to authenticate with Liftosaur and have an active subscription before reading or changing programs, history, gyms, equipment, exercise settings, or measurements.

payload.name: Jitty Property Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for homes for sale in the UK directly from within ChatGPT.

Instead of rigid filters, describe what you're looking for in plain English. For example: 

- a three-bedroom house under £750k within 45 minutes by public transport of Liverpool Street
- a flat with high ceilings and no road noise
- or a family home near good primary schools and green space.

You can search for details that are usually hard to filter for like being close to a pub, a large garden, or space for a dedicated home office.

The app turns your description into a live property search and shows listings currently on the market that match it. You can refine results by adding or adjusting requirements, all without leaving ChatGPT.

It's built for people who want a more natural way to find homes and who care about how a place actually feels to live in, not just its specs.

payload.name: Luxauto
payload.summaryOriginal: Cars and moto to buy and lease
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Luxauto helps you find cars and motorcycles to buy or lease in a simple, conversational way. Just describe what you’re looking for — budget, type of vehicle, or lifestyle needs — and Luxauto will guide you with relevant suggestions and listings from the largest vehicle selection in Luxembourg and the Greater Region (France, Belgium, and Germany).

Whether you’re searching for a family car, a city vehicle, or something more specific, the app helps you explore options, refine your criteria, and quickly access matching offers from the Luxauto marketplace.

Designed to make vehicle search easier, faster, and more intuitive.

payload.name: Municibid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search active Municibid government surplus auctions, review sold comps, and get rough market value estimates based on historical auction results.

payload.name: Autovit.ro
payload.description: 在 Autovit 找到你的梦想座驾
payload.summaryOriginal: Find your dream car in Autovit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your dream car in Romania using everyday language. Skip the complex filters and search forms. With Autovit, simply describe what you're looking for - "SUV with low mileage, great for family of 4" or "recent model, city car."

Key features:

1. Advanced Search: Describe your ideal car in natural language
2. Relevant results: Get matches for your search
3. Interactive refinement: Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search 

Whether you're a first-time buyer or seasoned car enthusiast, Autovit makes car buying as simple as having a conversation.

payload.name: Burger King
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With the official BURGER KING® app, explore our menu and find your nearest BK® restaurant anytime, anywhere. And in most locations, you can even order ahead.

Specific features include:
- Find your BK®: Locate your nearest BURGER KING® restaurant and never leave those flame-grilled cravings unfulfilled.
- Offers: Discover the hottest offers and deals right from your mobile device.
- Menu: Explore your BK® favorites and discover our hottest new menu additions. Plus, you can browse item descriptions at any time.

payload.name: atHome
payload.summaryOriginal: Find properties to buy or rent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
atHome.lu, Luxembourg’s leading real estate platform, now integrates directly into your ChatGPT experience.

Search for apartments, houses, and investment opportunities using natural language — just describe what you’re looking for. Browse listings with photos, pricing, and key details directly in the chat, displayed in a smooth carousel format.

Try prompts like:
- Show me 2-bedroom apartments for rent in Luxembourg City under €1,700
- Find houses for sale in Bettembourg with a garden under €1.5M
- I’m looking for a penthouse with an open view in Ettelbruck
- Show traditional farmhouses to renovate in Diekirch

Whether you’re filtering by budget, size, location, or specific features, atHome.lu helps you instantly explore real estate opportunities across Luxembourg and the Greater Region — all within the flow of your conversation.

payload.name: foodora
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
foodora lets users discover nearby food delivery restaurants, search for vendors and dishes, and browse full menus with prices, ratings, delivery estimates, and active promotions. Each result includes deep links so the user can continue to order in the foodora app or website. Results render in interactive vendor and menu card widgets.

This is only available in Sweden for now; other countries are coming soon.

payload.name: Digimarket
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Digimarket helps verified businesses find and list excess industrial inventory. Search by OEM part number, brand, category, quantity, unit, and price for cable, terminal blocks, ferrules, connectors, breakers, contactors, sensors, and related materials. Sellers prepare Excel-based listings in Talos; buyers discover available stock and contact sellers. Business verification is required for marketplace actions.

payload.name: Le Parisien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Accédez aux informations du Parisien : retrouvez les dernières actualités, recherchez des articles et suivez nos directs des grands événements facilement depuis ChatGPT.

Une façon simple et rapide de rester informé de l’actualité avec Le Parisien

payload.name: Rentals.ca Rental Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Canadian rental listings by city or nearby landmark and view matching apartments, homes, prices, photos, and locations in ChatGPT. Users can search by city, apply common filters such as rent, beds, baths, parking, pets, furnished status, lease terms, availability, and verified listings, or search near a landmark, university, building, or station. Results include concise listing summaries for ChatGPT and an interactive widget with listing cards, a map, pagination, and links back to Rentals.ca listing pages.

payload.name: Access Yami
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Yami helps users shop the largest Asian grocery & lifestyle store in North America directly inside ChatGPT. Users can take a Brand Taste Identity (BTI) quiz to discover their snack persona and get personalized picks, search and browse 10,000+ products by keyword, category, or brand, see trending best-sellers, link their Yami account, add items to their real Yami cart, and get a checkout link to complete purchase on yami.com.

payload.name: CellFusion C
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CellFusion C helps users find CellFusionC skincare products that match their skin type, concerns, preferred texture, use case, and requested category. It searches the Cafe24 product catalog, ranks suitable products, and displays recommendation cards with product images, prices, purchase links, and concise guidance.

payload.name: Bites
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bites is an AI-native ordering platform that lets people discover restaurants, browse full menus, and place direct orders from local restaurants — all from ChatGPT, without switching to a delivery app.

Customers get the convenience of AI-powered ordering while seeing in-store menu pricing, with no markups or hidden fees. They can search by cuisine or location, ask for recommendations, customize meals, and build group orders in natural language.

Examples:

"Order from Popeyes in San Jose."
"Order 2 Not So Fried Chicken sandwiches from Mendocino Farms, no sauce, with gluten-free bread."
"Build a vegetarian-friendly office lunch order for 10 people from Boltiful Santa Clara under $20 per person. Add few desserts for the team to share."
"Show me the menu for Curry Up Now and help me pick something spicy."

For restaurants, Bites enables direct, AI-powered ordering with no commissions, no markups, and full ownership of customer relationships. Restaurants can reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps while preserving margins and serving customers through the channels they already use.

In short, Bites combines the convenience of delivery apps with the economics of ordering directly from restaurants.

payload.name: LFmall
payload.description: 发现成就自我的品味，LFmall AI 购物
payload.summaryOriginal: 나를 나답게 만드는 취향 발견, LFmall AI 쇼핑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
복잡한 검색 대신 대화로 쇼핑하세요. LFmall은 당신의 스타일과 상황(TPO)을 이해하여 가장 '나다운' 패션과 라이프스타일 아이템을 찾아드립니다.
수만 개의 프리미엄 브랜드 상품 중 당신에게 딱 맞는 상품을 즉시 추천 받고, 공식몰만의 안전한 배송과 단독 혜택까지 한 번에 경험해 보세요. 
단순한 구매를 넘어 당신의 취향을 깊이 있게 완성해 드립니다.
